handoff_instructions: M2-T06 done. Added packages/core/src/services/webhooks.ts: recordWebhookReceipt (idempotent insert on webhook_receipts via ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id) DO NOTHING, falling back to a select of the existing row so a duplicate delivery returns it instead of writing a second row), getWebhookReceipt, and updateWebhookReceiptStatus (updates status, stamps processed_at once the row leaves 'received', throws NotFoundError for an unknown id). All three take a raw Tx and always run asService, matching the createOrganizationWithOwner precedent for server-internal code that runs before any tenant/org is known; webhook_receipts already has RLS enabled with all privileges revoked from authenticated (0001/0002), so no migration was needed and no client policy was added. Exported the new service from packages/core/src/index.ts (one line). Added packages/core/test/webhook-receipts.test.ts: duplicate-returns-existing-row, cross-provider distinctness, org association, status update + processed_at stamping, not-found, null lookup, and a direct-SQL check that no authenticated or anonymous client role can read/write webhook_receipts. pnpm lint, typecheck and test all pass (packages/core now 122 passing, 7 skipped, up from the prior 115). Only files touched: packages/core/src/services/webhooks.ts (new), packages/core/src/index.ts (+1 export), packages/core/test/webhook-receipts.test.ts (new). Next: M2-T07 "Webhook route handler" (apps/web API route that verifies signatures via a VoiceProvider/SmsProvider adapter and calls recordWebhookReceipt before processing).
